subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this scoped bootstrap-context runtime change land with the supplied focused terminal proof after validation is green, or should maintainers require live embedded_run/channel liveness proof or a smaller split first?
rationale: The patch appears to fix the right owner-owned bootstrap surfaces without growing the public SDK, but focused tests and terminal proof do not fully settle live session interleaving and prompt-context ordering risk in this hot path.

options.title: Accept Scoped Runtime Risk
options.body: Merge after failing validation is cleared if the owner accepts the tested compatibility envelope for broad glob traversal and bootstrap hook interleaving.

options.title: Require Live Liveness Proof
options.body: Ask for one redacted embedded_run or Crabbox/Testbox run showing timers or channel I/O remain responsive during a broad extra-bootstrap scan.

options.title: Split Runtime Surfaces
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want async reads, glob walking, hook yielding, and timing diagnostics reviewed and landed as smaller independent changes.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Runtime Risk
recommendation.body: Merge after failing validation is cleared if the owner accepts the tested compatibility envelope for broad glob traversal and bootstrap hook interleaving.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the bootstrap file read and internal hook contracts changed by this PR.
